build_cls_preprocessor: build a ClsDataPreprocessor with mean, std, and batch augmentations like mixup and cutmix for classification
build_selfsup_preprocessor: build a SelfSupDataPreprocessor to normalize and convert BGR to RGB for self-supervised multi-view inputs
build_twonorm_preprocessor: build a TwoNormDataPreprocessor that normalizes prediction and target images with separate mean and std values
build_video_preprocessor: build a VideoDataPreprocessor to normalize and convert video frames in NCHW or NCTHW format
build_multimodal_preprocessor: build a MultiModalDataPreprocessor to normalize and pad image inputs for image-text multimodal tasks
